events.title: Endless Mode Update
events.summary: Hello Volunteers,This will most likely be the last content update other than bug fixes, some quality of life and variety, like more arenas or accessories.A demo is in the works as well.Here's what's newEndless mode will now be unlocked after winning 10 battles.The tutorial is now fully voice acted, some lines will be improved or changed at some pointSeven new achievements have been added.When training volunteers only the base attributes will be shown, text has been added to help make that clear.

events.title: New Patch - New Mini Game
events.summary: Hello Volunteers,Small bug fixesA new pinball style mini game has been added to the regular gameA new mini game only mode can be selected from the main menu, this mode includes a local leaderboard

events.title: Newest Update Notes
events.summary: Hello Volunteers,Here's a summary of the most recent patch.A friendly yet stubborn husky has been added to the main area and will roam around causing troubleMany small bug fixesMany small tweaks no one will noticeYou can now press esc during "Smash House" and "Escape From Bathtime" in order to pause, view controls, and leave early if desiredNew mini-game in the style of an endless runner has been added
